title: SMS workflow reminder retry count tracking

comments.text: logic: This condition deletes reminders with retryCount > 1, meaning reminders are deleted after just one retry attempt. This seems too aggressive - consider if this should be a higher threshold like > 3 or > 5 to allow multiple retry attempts.
logic: No maximum retry limit is enforced. Without a cap (e.g., retryCount < 5), reminders could be retried indefinitely, potentially causing performance issues over time.
